title: The Egg That Hums
text: In a nest of melted gold, cooled into ripples, sits one egg the size of a barrel. It is warm to the touch, and it hums a low note you feel in your teeth. The hum gets louder when your fiercest fighter is near, as if it already knows them.

options.label: Your fiercest fighter cracks it open and drinks deep.

outcomes.text: By evening scales have begun to spread across their skin. The hunger follows, and after it the fire.
It tastes of smoke and iron. They rise stronger than before, with a heat in their blood that never fades.
Something in the yolk fights its way back up, tearing at them from the inside.

options.label: Wrap it up and carry it out carefully, before anything comes looking for it.

outcomes.text: In the dark of the pack it falls silent, a warm weight against the spine. Scholars at home will pay well for such a thing.
Its mother wants it back. You hear her wings long before she fills the sky above you.

options.label: Smash it before it hatches. The world has monsters enough.

outcomes.text: It dies like a coal dropped in rain. The gold of the nest is still gold, so you take every piece of it.
Its mother heard the shell break. Her shadow darkens the sky as she comes down upon you.
